temporal_boundary.reason: Static review found that A1's common coefficient vector does not define a common physical probe when an SVD null basis rotates between start, final, precision or radius probes.

finding.problem: For an equal nullspace, an SVD may replace V2 by V2*R for an arbitrary orthogonal R. Reusing the same coordinate vector c in each local basis changes v=V2*c, so A1's start/final projected-spectrum ratio could measure basis choice rather than projected-operator order.
finding.scope: Audit-only ell=65 projected-order and final correction/reserve probes. Actual trajectory iterations and ell=1 step-safety probes are unchanged.

physical_probe_transport.trajectory_scope: Construct one reference per primary trajectory and per confirmation trajectory from that trajectory's frozen start. Do not share a reference across different starts.
physical_probe_transport.candidate_reference: At the frozen trajectory start, use the eligible candidate right-null basis V2_ref from the charged 256-bit, Jacobian-radius-0.5 decomposition.
physical_probe_transport.analytic_reference: At the frozen trajectory start, use the eligible analytic-control right-null basis V2_ref from the charged 256-bit analytic-Jacobian decomposition.
physical_probe_transport.reference_coefficient: Generate c65 exactly once from the A1 SplitMix64 rule with ell=65 and the frozen k, and set v_ref=V2_ref*c65. Normalize v_ref in two-norm and require a finite nonzero norm.
physical_probe_transport.local_transport: For each start or final audit basis Q=V2, compute c_local=Q'*v_ref. Require a finite norm(c_local,2)>0, then set v_local=Q*(c_local/norm(c_local,2)).
physical_probe_transport.subspace_gate: For every transported start/final basis, compute projection_loss=norm(v_ref-Q*(Q'*v_ref),2) and sin_theta_max=sqrt(max(0,1-sigma_min(V2_ref'*Q)^2)). Require finite values and sin_theta_max<=1e-6; equality passes. A zero projection, nonfinite value, dimension drift or subspace-gate failure is typed unknown.
physical_probe_transport.trace: Persist trajectory identity within the variant artifact, k, ell=65, c65, V2_ref provenance, v_ref, local probe precision/radius, c_local, norm(c_local), v_local, projection_loss, sin_theta_max, bound and decision. No case/family/Gold field enters the calculation.

overrides.a1_projected_order_direction: Every B_order_start and B_order_final in the A1 persistence gate uses transported v_local derived from the trajectory's fixed v_ref, not a newly interpreted local c65.
overrides.a1_final_audit_direction: Every ell=65 final unapplied q audit and configuration finite-difference reserve uses the same transported v_local. Thus radius/precision and start/final comparisons represent one physical probe up to the accepted subspace projection.
overrides.unchanged_step_direction: The ell=1 step-safety audit and actual ell=1:64 trajectory steps retain A1's locally generated c and v=V2*c.
overrides.basis_invariance: U2 and V2 may rotate inside their accepted subspaces. With a fixed physical v, sorted singular values of U2'*D2F[v,V2] are invariant under orthogonal left/right basis changes.
overrides.control_independence: Candidate and analytic control duplicate the transport, angle, projection and trace implementation. Only this frozen formula and artifact field contract are common.

superseding_freeze_order: Bind the immutable S4 preregistration, final A1, this A2, generator-scaffold commit and generator-scaffold source hash.
After the host-exclusive performance run ends, execute input/scaffold tests without candidate or analytic-control implementation present.

Materialize and commit the development input manifest and separate Gold artifact; the manifest must contain hashes for the preregistration, A1, A2, generator scaffold and current manifest-builder source.
Only from that committed input-freeze parent may candidate and independent analytic-control source be added.
Freeze all implementation/applicability hashes before the first development outcome.
Do not materialize locked inputs unless the unchanged development gate passes.
